description: React component for editing and managing an attribute-based access control policy in Mattermost's admin console, including policy creation, editing, channel assignment, and deletion.

methods.name: loadPage
methods.description: Loads policy details, channels, and access control fields when the component mounts or policyId changes.

methods.name: preSaveCheck
methods.description: Validates that the policy has a name and expression before saving.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles creating/updating the policy, assigning channels, updating active status, creating sync jobs, and navigation after save.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Handles unassigning channels and deleting the policy.

methods.name: addToNewChannels
methods.description: Adds selected channels to the policy.

methods.name: handlePolicyActiveStatusChange
methods.description: Updates the active status of the policy.

methods.name: hasChannels
methods.description: Checks if the policy has any assigned channels.
